'''Lha-Mi's ''Peacemaker''''' was the personal [[Peacemaker-class cruiser|''Peacemaker''-class cruiser]] of [[Lha-Mi]], [[Je'daii Temple Master]] of [[Stav Kesh]], the Temple of Martial Arts, during the reign of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]].<ref name="Into the Void" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Description==
Laid out to accommodate a large number of people, the living quarters of Lha-Mi's ''Peacemaker'' notably had a circular table surrounded by eight seats for holding meetings.<ref name="Into the Void" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'' {{Ab|Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void (audiobook)}} {{1st}}
